# Ryan Phelan, The Strongbow Group

> Ryan Phelan is a go-to-market advisor to B2B technology companies. He helps leadership teams close the Clarity Gap, the distance between how a company understands itself and how its market experiences it, through two disciplines: Go-to-Market Alignment (inside the company) and Go-to-Market Translation (outside it). The Strongbow Group LLC is the practice.

The Clarity Gap is what opens when a company can no longer tell one story about itself and starts telling that story to itself instead of to its customer. It opens from two directions: internal misalignment across teams, and failure to translate the story to the market. Go-to-Market Alignment is the inside work, getting leadership, product, marketing, sales, customer success, and AI to reinforce one market position through a six-part method. Go-to-Market Translation is the outside work, deconstructing a company's go-to-market and rebuilding it into a message and customer relationship the market understands and values.

Ryan has nearly three decades across every side of B2B technology: vendor, client, agency, operator, CEO, and board. He was CEO of RPE Origin (2021-2026), the 2023 ANA Thought Leader of the Year, Chairman emeritus of the Email Experience Council, and has written 100+ columns for MarTech. Selected work includes Sherwin-Williams, TJ Maxx, Synchrony Financial, HP, FedEx, Capital One, Microsoft, Wells Fargo, Allstate, Sam's Club, and lululemon.
